explode.basis: absolute canonical rest + supplied factor × editorial offset; no voltage coupling

indicator.note: Battery case never changes scale. Zero hides indicator.

wireless.zero: Lower face of receiver back window contacts top face of pad at canonical rest
wireless.end_lead: QI_END_LEAD local X endpoint, X scale=(.034-endpoint)/.008
wireless.coaxial: QI_TX_AXIS / QI_RX_AXIS remain same world X/Z
wireless.legacy_correction: Actual legacy displacement .15 scene units/mm = 5× at 30units/metre, not .18/6×. Asset/controller use true metres. Frontend may separately magnify/label diagram presentation.

heat.input: supplied colour; estimated heat cue, not measured temperature

capacitor.note: Fixed plates; charges and voltage text are frontend-owned. No voltage integration.

limitations: Generic educational construction, not a proprietary replica or CAD/manufacturing deliverable.
Browser glass is alpha blended; offline refraction differs.
All five stations overview consumes more draw calls than a single active apparatus.
No frontend lesson integration or physical device/AR validation in this asset-only handoff.
